quizGuardRationale: Direct symmetric nontransitive guards address defensible displayed answers, not unrestricted Japanese substitution. Actual labels and complete ordinary secondary senses were inspected; no shared-topic clique is assumed. No existing word metadata/exclusions change.

原産 guards native/place-origin labels and broad origin/nature wording; provenance is not arbitrary current habitat. 原始 separately guards beginning/origin labels, not every old object. These are separate neighborhoods, not a transitive origin clique.
研修 guards training/practice/study/education answers, while the in-service title remains a useful tendency, not an employees-only boundary.
厳重 guards strictness, severe/intense treatment, strong protest, thorough enforcement and secure/safe guarding labels. This does not teach physical hardness, muscular strength or every person as 厳重.
謙遜 guards 謙虚 directly, plus modest holding-back/obliged responses; existing 謙虚 guards do not transitively protect those new pairs.
県庁 guards actual broad government/office/bureau/workspace answers, including 庁 directly rather than relying on 官庁's guard. Administrative category specificity remains explicit.
限度 guards limits/bounds, restriction, scope/range, degree and temporal-limit wording, including ordinary secondary meanings; no automatic exact numerical threshold is taught.
現に guards factual actually/really/in-fact/reality/indeed wording. Prose distinguishes disclosure, evaluative intensity and bare actuality instead of demanding unique English labels.
原理 guards principle/doctrine, theory/view and basics/foundation labels. Raw theory is qualified but not rejected. It is not automatically every reason or source material.
原料 guards physical material/ingredients, base/seed material and natural-resource labels. Informational 資料 and production equipment remain distinct.
碁 has no guards for unrelated 五/語 homophones. 工員 has no guards based solely on sharing a workplace, employment or coworker relationship.
恋しい guards yearning/desiring and affection labels where dear/beloved could yield ambiguous English answers; longing remains required in the teaching.
請う guards direct request/beg/ask/invite/wish/pray answers, including actual 注文 request sense rather than goods orders alone. It does not share an identity with unrelated こう.
強引 guards unreasonable/forcible, forceful manner and brazen-pushy behavior wording; ordinary strength is not coercion.
公害 guards contamination/pollution, public nuisance, harm/damage and noise-pollution wording, not the unrelated 郊外 homophone.
高級 guards superior quality/excellence, luxury/lavishness and broad high/costly/good/rank wording, including the explicitly additional rank sense. Prose does not equate price, quality and status.
公共 guards public/communal, society/public, public institution, shared/joint and general-public wording. This does not assert government ownership or equate every neighborhood group.

工芸 guards actual art and technique/technology labels supported by its making-technique and useful/aesthetic work range. Manufacturing industry is distinguished rather than automatically treated as industrial arts.
sourceAccessLimits: Twenty new articles cover N2:482-N2:501; none is a reused principal article. Community-list membership is not an official modern JLPT syllabus.
Four primary-form reciprocal N2 pairs: 県/県庁, 庁/県庁, 恋/恋しい and 芸/工芸. No additional kanji/stroke articles are fabricated.
Primary missing kanji cards 修, 厳, 謙, 遜, 顕, 微, 鏡, 碁, 請 and 級 remain written metadata; every existing primary component is substantively linked.
請う praying/wishing and 高級 high rank/level are additional senses, not separately established N2 assignments. 原始 selects both origin and primeval senses.
All baseline identities, readings, titles, written-kanji arrays and easier levels remain preserved; this batch adds no baseline-exclusion exception.
Original pedagogical examples are not corpus attestations or native-speaker certification. Public access failures and navigation-only or contradictory unsourced pages are not treated as verification.
Author receipts are not independent reviewer retrieval. Initial reviewer derivative removes only quizGuardRationale; source/mapping notes remain author assertions to assess.
